title: tidy ignores an operator answer dated in the future, and the docs say what guards the answer key
goal: bl_clean.answer_of ignores an answer whose time is later than now, so a value written straight into coord with a far-future time never makes a candidate removable; kb/_self/backlog.md says the agent-session refusal guards the tidy --decide command, not the coord key tidy-answer/KEY

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, json, time
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
ENV = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(("GIT_", "KB_COORD"))}
ENV.pop("CLAUDECODE", None)
ENV.update(KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite"), GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1",
           GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t@example.com", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t@example.com")
def g(*a, cwd):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *a], cwd=cwd, env=ENV, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
def tool(*a, env=None, ok=(0,)):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env or ENV, timeout=300)
    assert r.returncode in ok, (a, r.returncode, r.stdout[-800:], r.stderr[-800:])
    return r
O, C = os.path.join(T, "origin.git"), os.path.join(T, "clone")
g("init", "-q", "--bare", "-b", "main", O, cwd=T)
g("clone", "-q", O, C, cwd=T)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "backlog"))
open(os.path.join(C, "backlog.json"), "w").write('{"item_dir": "kb/_self/backlog"}\n')
open(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "backlog", ".keep"), "w").close()
g("add", "-A", cwd=C); g("commit", "-qm", "base", cwd=C); g("push", "-q", "origin", "main", cwd=C); g("fetch", "-q", cwd=C)
WT = os.path.join(C, ".claude", "worktrees")
def wt(name, branch=None, at="HEAD"):
    p = os.path.join(WT, name)
    g("worktree", "add", "-q", *(["-b", branch] if branch else ["--detach"]), p, at, cwd=C)
    return p
n = lambda p: os.path.normcase(os.path.realpath(p))
def own(p, cls, *a, env=None):
    return tool("_tools/backlog.py", "--root", C, "own", str(p), "--class", cls, *a, env=env)
def rows(*a):
    return json.loads(tool("_tools/backlog.py", "--root", C, "tidy", "--json", *a).stdout)
def by_path(rs, cls=None):
    return {n(x["path"]): x for x in rs if "path" in x and (cls is None or x.get("class") == cls)}
S = ENV["KB_COORD_STORE"]
it = {"id": "ST-aaaaaaaa", "kind": "story", "title": "t", "status": "doing", "priority": "P2", "rank": 0, "goal": "g",
      "checks": [{"run": ["true"]}], "touches": ["x"]}
open(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "backlog", "ST-aaaaaaaa.json"), "w").write(json.dumps(it, indent=2) + "\n")
g("add", "-A", cwd=C); g("commit", "-qm", "item", cwd=C); g("push", "-q", "origin", "main", cwd=C); g("fetch", "-q", cwd=C)
st = wt("agent-stale", "work/ST-aaaaaaaa"); own(st, "worktree", "--item", "ST-aaaaaaaa", "--session", "s-gone")
x = by_path(rows("--older-than", "0"), "worktree")[n(st)]
assert x["verdict"] == "ask" and "claim" in x["reason"] and x.get("key"), x
key = x["key"]
tool("_tools/coord.py", "--store", S, "put", "tidy-answer/" + key, "--value", json.dumps({"answer": "remove", "at": 9999999999}), "--revision", "0")
tool("_tools/backlog.py", "--root", C, "tidy", "--apply", "--older-than", "0", ok=(0, 1))
assert os.path.isdir(st), "a future-dated answer written straight into coord removed the candidate"

notes: SP-ep7cyuob review (S2): bl_clean.decide refuses only by CLAUDECODE (bl_authority.in_agent_session), and coord keys have no protection: any session with Bash can `coord.py put tidy-answer/KEY` itself; answer_of accepts an `at` in the future, so such an answer never goes stale. Bounded: only an ask candidate (clean, merged, idle, no lease or live process) can go, and git worktree remove has no --force.
